column1: # NEXT-FW-INTEG-01R frozen CTest inventory, identical for clang, gcc and sanitizer.

# persistent settings record, torn saves, boot restore) and test-foc-can (CANSimple) and
# test-foc-trig (ROM-01 foc_sincosf accuracy) and test-foc-parameter-table (PARAM-01) and
# test-foc-thermal and test-foc-runtime-thermal (THERMAL-01 NTC, derating, I2t) and
# test-foc-board-cogging (COG-01 CAL-8 sweep and fit) and test-foc-board-encoder-lut
# (ENC-01 CAL-9 fit); test-legacy-sincos-baseline left with the
